title: Clinical Trial of CoQ10 for Mild-to-Moderate Statin-Associated Muscle Symptoms

sections.abstract:
This study will evaluate whether a dietary supplement, coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10), will improve muscle symptoms, such as muscle aches, pains, cramps, and/or weakness, which are experienced by some individuals who use statin medications.

Posted outcomes: Percentage of Participants With Reduction in Muscle Pain Associated With Statin Use. timeframe=4 weeks. Coenzyme Q10=53; Placebo=65
